{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders, refunded orders, and non-targeted channels
df_clean = df[
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search']))
]

# Compute average revenue per order by channel and customer_segment
df_grouped = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'], as_index=False)['revenue'].mean()

# Print only the values we need for evidence
print(f"Average revenue for email channel (loyal): {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['channel'] == 'email', 'revenue'].iloc[0]:.2f}")
print(f"Average revenue for paid_search channel (loyal): {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['channel'] == 'paid_search', 'revenue'].iloc[0]:.2f}")
print(f"Average revenue for email channel (returning): {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['channel'] == 'email', 'revenue'].iloc[2]:.2f}")
print(f"Average revenue for paid_search channel (returning): {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['channel'] == 'paid_search', 'revenue'].iloc[2]:.2f}")
print(f"Average revenue for email channel (new): {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['channel'] == 'email', 'revenue'].iloc[1]:.2f}")
print(f"Average revenue for paid_search channel (new): {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['channel'] == 'paid_search', 'revenue'].iloc[1]:.2f}")

# Also print the full grouped table for audit
df_grouped"}
